title: House walks now run all the way to the sidewalk
items: On Prairie Avenue and its cross streets, 51 house walks, side walks and drives stopped on a strip of grass short of the public sidewalk. Each now runs on until it meets it, as the period photographs show.
The gap was the city's one-foot margin between the lot line and the sidewalk, wider at 1812 Prairie and at the Pullman glasshouse ground at 18th and Calumet.
The joining paving is our reconstruction and is listed in the Liberties.
